title: Tintinnabulum mapping profile
description: How one kind of data becomes events. A profile is a document, not code: it can be committed, reviewed, diffed and shared, so a producer adopting Tintinnabulum writes one instead of writing a transformer.

profile.description: Version of this document format. Omitted means the current one.

name.description: What this profile is called. A profile stored in profiles/<name>.json can be selected with ?profile=<name>.

description.description: What kind of data this expects, in one sentence.

where.description: An expression. When present, a payload is turned into an event only if this is truthy. Use it to drop what you do not want to hear, at the source rather than by filtering later.

map.description: One entry per event field. Each value is an expression in the mapping language, or {"const": value} for a fixed value. Only `magnitude` is required: it is the one field the engine cannot invent.

spec.description: An expression string, or a constant.

oneOf.description: An expression. `$` is the payload. See spec/README.md for the grammar and the function list.
